# SIP2.19: Add 1 Ark to LazyVault_LowerRisk_USDCe Fleet on sonic

## Summary
This is a cross-chain governance proposal to add 1 new Ark to the existing LazyVault_LowerRisk_USDCe Fleet on sonic.

## Motivation
Expanding this fleet with additional an Ark will enhance the protocol's capabilities on sonic.

## Technical Details
- Hub Chain: base (Production)
- Target Chain: sonic
- Fleet Commander: 0x507A2D9E87DBD3076e65992049C41270b47964f8
- Number of Ark to add: 1

## New Ark Address
1. `0x8fAF711962E89047CB26Fb4B4F8Dbd578069db53`

## Specifications
### Actions
This proposal will execute the following actions on sonic:
1. Grant COMMANDER_ROLE to Fleet Commander for the Ark
2. Add the Ark to the Fleet Commander

### Cross-chain Mechanism
This proposal uses LayerZero to execute governance actions across chains.
